steps.text: Hey 😊 Before my day gets away from me, did you sleep well?
I did. How about you?
Pretty well, considering I set an alarm and then argued with it twice 😭
Did you win?
I got up. Interpret that however you like
Work today?
Until six, then I need to pick up a couple of things on the way home
I'm going to be busy for most of the day, so don't be surprised if I'm quiet
I'll try not to take being abandoned for a shopping list personally
It has considerably less interesting things to say than you 😌
High praise
I was thinking about yesterday at your place while I made breakfast
Have you finally admitted I was right about the film?
No. The bit where I had my head on your shoulder
Oh. I liked that bit too
You went quiet for once. It was very nice ❤️
I could offer that service again
Please do. I'd like another afternoon like that soon
We'll find one. Have you actually eaten yet?
Yes, before you start. Look
You look lovely
Thank you 😊 The breakfast is just out of frame, but I promise it exists
I'll take your word for it
There is something I wanted to ask you before I leave
{{name:aiden}} messaged me this morning
He's asked if I'd like to come over to his place tonight, just the two of us
No arcade rematch attached to the invitation?
I checked. Apparently he can spend an evening without a scoreboard 😌
I'd like to go. Is that okay with you?
He messaged me about meeting again tonight
The guy from the café?
Yes 😊 He's invited me to have dinner at his place
Apparently he's ready to defend his cooking in person
That sounds like an evening worth surviving the workday for
I'd like to go. Are you okay with me going to his place?
Yes, sweetheart. I am ❤️
I meant what I said. I'd like you to do what you feel like doing
I know. I still wanted to ask how you felt about tonight
And I'm glad you did. You don't need to talk yourself out of something you want
Okay 😊 I'll go home and get ready first, then head over around eight
Take care of yourself, though. Keep your phone charged and text me when you get there
I will. I've got the address, and I can get a taxi back whenever I need to
If I decide to stay instead, I'll let you know too
Good. I don't need a message every five minutes. I just want to know you're okay
That part I can promise ❤️
And you can tell me if you're feeling nervous again
A little. But that doesn’t mean I wish you weren’t going
Yesterday helped. I liked knowing we could still just be ourselves together
We can. Including me stealing your cushion ❤️
That part was never in doubt
You're being very calm about this
I'm smiling at my phone, actually 🙂
Good. Then we have matching stupid faces
Yours is prettier
Now you're just trying to keep me here ❤️
Right, I need to leave before my quiet morning becomes me running down the street
Have a good day. Eat something proper during your break
Look at you taking over my job 😌
Somebody has to remind you when you’re busy
I love you. I'll text you when I'm home and getting ready ❤️
Love you too. Speak tonight
